method: Manual static inspection of captured webpack-style modules, their export bindings, scoped selectors and direct consumers. Capture ordinal references identify files; original module names and code are not published.

selectors.algorithm: Start at current_node, follow mapping parents with repeated-node guard, reverse the path, and return present message objects.
selectors.ui_meaning: All available messages on one selected ancestry path, not all alternative branches.

selectors.algorithm: Follow parents from the selected node and stop at the latest message satisfying a predicate; the default predicate matches a user-authored message. Reverse the resulting window.
selectors.ui_meaning: Messages for the selected recent user turn and subsequent steps, not the entire conversation.

selectors.algorithm: Read the current selected node and mapping, follow parents with a cycle guard, gather user-authored message identities and reverse into root-to-leaf order.
selectors.ui_meaning: User-message identifiers on the currently selected ancestry branch.

selectors.algorithm: Scan messages on selected ancestry for automation references in metadata, tool responses and supported widget structures; permit limited incremental updates.
selectors.ui_meaning: Feature-specific automation references, NOT visible transcript messages.

selectors.algorithm: Extract eligible page references from selected ancestry tool messages and update a separate page-reference collection.
selectors.ui_meaning: Page resource references, NOT visible transcript messages.

verified_consumers.behavior: A React conversation-control component subscribes to the current-turn selector, filters assistant and other message roles, and derives whether an answer-now or skip control is eligible. Actual rendered interaction not observed.
Composer-related selectors consult the current-turn messages to determine last user-message context and related local-input state.
Derived selectors and local helpers receive the full path as message objects when calculating conversation-level context.
A side-panel coordination path reads the selected conversation message set while synchronizing local panel/turn state.
Two policy paths compare the last selected-branch user message identity with the message under evaluation before triggering a potential placement.
A derived selector takes the final selected-branch user message identity and combines it with response visibility state for eligibility.
Feature selectors filter selected-path automation references by origin and correlate them with candidate automation records.

limitations: Static React-hook syntax establishes a component-side subscription path, but a runtime render or user-visible button state has not been observed.
Selected ancestry and recent-turn selector outputs are not equivalent to rendered message DOM; feature filtering, hidden messages and rendering policies remain to be traced.
The previously mislabeled automation-reference collector is distinct from both ancestry-message selectors.
An exported state selector's existence does not establish that all captured consumers are loaded or executed in the same session.
Only capture-local resource ordinals and authored descriptions are published; no raw JavaScript, original module identifier, message data or network endpoint is included.
